ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: friends abroad
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Win a faction over until they count as allies: someone to trade with, and someone who answers when you call for help.

plain.li: Everyone out there is either selling to us or shooting at us. I'd like at least one faction we can count on.
A few gifts, a favor or two and some honest trading, and in a month one of the factions could be on our side.
[afterraid] We held them off alone. Next time I'd like someone to call.
[small] There are a handful of us and a whole planet of them. We need friends.

warm.li: I keep thinking about the traders who came through. They had families too. Let's be good neighbors.
I don't want us facing this world on our own. Let's make some friends out there.

blunt.li: We need allies. I don't much like people, but people with guns are useful.
Pick a faction and send them silver until they like us.

cheerful.li: Friends abroad! Caravans going back and forth, and maybe a party once a year.
Imagine a whole faction who's happy to see us coming! I'll bake them something.

gloomy.li: One day a raid will come that we can't stop on our own. I'd like there to be someone to send for.
If we all died out here, it would be weeks before anyone noticed. I'd like that to change.

cold.li: Allies send soldiers we don't have to feed between raids.
We have no goodwill with anyone worth having. We should build some up while things are quiet.

plain.li: They call us friends now. Let's keep it that way.
If we called for help now, someone would come.

warm.li: We have real friends out there now. I'm going to wave at their next caravan until my arm hurts.

blunt.li: Good. Now we've got someone to borrow soldiers from.

cheerful.li: Allies! Somebody send them a fruitcake.

gloomy.li: They're our allies for now. People change their minds, but it's better than nothing.

cold.li: Alliance secured. Their soldiers cost us nothing until we need them.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the finer things
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Make two new items of excellent quality or better. Furniture, art, clothing and weapons all count.

plain.li: Everything we own was made in a hurry. I'd like a couple of things that weren't.
We're past sticks and string. Let's make something we're proud of.
[poor] We can't afford much, so what we do make should be made well.
[tribal|medieval] Our grandparents' grandparents made things that lasted. We can too.

warm.li: I want to make something lovely for this place. Something people stop and touch on their way past.

blunt.li: I'm sick of chairs that wobble. Give me time and good material and I'll stop complaining.
Our stuff is ugly. Give the crafters time and good material.

cheerful.li: Let's fill the place with things that are useful and pretty!

gloomy.li: Long after we're gone, someone will find whatever we leave behind. Let's leave something good.

cold.li: Excellent work lasts longer, works better and sells for far more than its materials.

plain.li: Look at the work in that. It took a week to make, and it shows.

warm.li: People keep stopping to run their hands over it on their way past.

cheerful.li: It's so beautiful I want to hug it!

cold.li: Two excellent pieces. The colony is measurably better made.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a masterwork
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Make one new item of masterwork quality. It takes a skilled crafter, good material and some luck; an inspired crafter has a better chance.

plain.li: I think I've got one great thing in me. I'd like the time to find out.
Somebody here is good enough to make a masterwork. Let's give them the bench and get out of the way.
[skill:Artistic] There's a sculpture I keep seeing when I close my eyes. I need to get it out.

warm.li: I want to make one thing for all of you that will still be here after we're gone.

blunt.li: I'm the best crafter on this rock and nothing I've made proves it yet.

cheerful.li: A real masterwork! People will be making up songs about it, at least around here.

gloomy.li: Everything we build burns eventually. I'd like to make one thing that's worth crying over.

cold.li: A masterwork is worth several times the same item at normal quality. It's the best return on materials we'll get.
[trait:Greedy] One masterwork is worth a whole caravan of ordinary goods. I've seen what traders pay.

plain.li: That's it. That's the one. Everybody come and look.

warm.li: It's for all of us. Everyone helped, even if they only cooked dinner.

blunt.li: Told you. Wash your hands before you touch it.

cheerful.li: A masterwork, made right here! I need to sit down.

gloomy.li: It's perfect. I'll probably never make anything this good again.

cold.li: Masterwork confirmed. Its value alone covers the materials many times over.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the long night
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Stockpile 300 wood before winter, enough fuel to keep the fires, stoves and heaters going through the cold months.

plain.li: The fires eat wood faster than we cut it. When the snow comes we'll be burning the furniture.
I can count the logs in the stockpile on my fingers, and winter's not far off. We need to cut.
[fall] The leaves are going. In a few weeks so are the trees we can reach. Cut now.
[tribal] The old ones say a woodpile should be taller than the tallest of us. Ours isn't.

warm.li: Let's fill the woodpile while the weather's good, so no one spends this winter cold.

blunt.li: No wood, no fire. No fire, no us. Grab an axe.

cheerful.li: A big woodpile, crackling fires and hot soup all winter! Grab an axe, it'll be fun.

gloomy.li: Last winter I dreamed I was frozen to my bed. I'd rather not find out if it was a prophecy.
[winter] Winter's here and the pile's already low. I've seen colonies end this way.

cold.li: Heating consumes fuel at a fixed rate. Our stock won't last the cold months. Cut more now, or lose people later.

plain.li: That's a proper woodpile. We'll have fires all winter.

warm.li: We'll all sleep warm this winter.

cheerful.li: Look at it, it's taller than me! We're going to be so toasty.

gloomy.li: Enough to last the winter. If the winter plays fair.

cold.li: Fuel reserves sufficient. Heating is no longer a limiting factor.
